paragraphs: Or Urion, of Tzaidan: see under the letter Gimel.[^1]

notes.text: The heading preserves Abba Guria and Abba Gurion; the body adds the alternative Urion of Tzaidan and a pointer under letter Gimel. These remain source name alternatives and an alphabetical placement instruction, without a historical identity binding.
